outline: 本課程內容為對二十世紀具特色的建築作品從事專題性的分析、研讀，以訓練學生運用建築史知識深入評析作品內涵的能力。授課採研討方式，研修者須自選一經認可之重要建築作品，在授課老師指導下進行分析、研討的操作。
schedule:
- The beginning of the 20th century architecture -
1. Alvar Aalto as the author of romanticism and regionalism
2. Frank Lloyd Wright and the American tradition
3. Le Corbuser and the new era of architectural expression
4. Mie van der Rohe, Schinkel and German tradition
5. I.M.Pei and the evolution of international style
6. Louis Kahn and the development of personal philosophy
7. Norman Foster, Richard Rogers and high-tech
8. Arata Isozaki and Japanese context
9. Frank Gehry as the artist and architect
10. Rem Koolhaas as a creator of new urbanism and architecture
11. Robert Venturi and the interpretation of signs
12. Aldo Rossi and European city and typology
13. New York Five as the reinvestors of modern architecture
14. Tadao Ando and the natural elements
15. Alvaro Siza and the poetic legend
16. Toyo Ito as the interpreter of communication and transparency
17. Steven Holl as the new kind of architect
18. Other equally important architects and their works

2. Jencks, Charles. ”Part Three: Post-Modern Architecture.” In The Language of Post-Modern Architecture. 6th ed. New York: Rizzoli, 1991
3. Frampton, Kenneth. ”Towards a Critical Regionalism: Six Points for an Architecture of Resistance.” In The Anti-Aesthetic: Essays on Postmodern Culture. Edited by Hal Foster. Seattle, WA: Bay Press, 1983
